query:
UPDATE rad_forms
        SET title = COALESCE($3, title),
            definition_json = COALESCE($4, definition_json),
            entity_id = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE entity_id END,
            updated_by = $7,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'DRAFT'
